# Word Rhythm

> Scripture for the rhythm of everyday life. A family of 7 Android Bible apps
> — KJV Bible, ASV Bible, WEB Bible, Biblia RVR, 和合本圣经, Bíblia AA, Bible Louis Segond 1910 — each built around
> 4 daily touchpoints: morning, day, evening, sleep.

## Daily rhythm (every app)

All 7 apps run the same 4 daily slots:

1. **Morning** (early morning)
2. **Day** (daytime)
3. **Evening** (early evening)
4. **Sleep** (21:00-04:59)

The fourth slot is a real slot, not a synonym for the third: it opens in the
evening and runs past midnight. Every app has before-bed devotional content —
the label is localised (Sleep, Sleep, Sleep, Noche, 睡前, Noite, Nuit).

Each devotional follows the same shape: time window, theme tag, the verse with
its reference, what the verse says, how to reflect, and a short prayer.

## Audio support (varies by translation)

Audio is the feature that differs between apps:

- **Sleep Audio — KJV Bible only.** Gentle nighttime Scripture
  reading with soft pacing and quiet pauses, plus peaceful background sounds.
- **Text-to-speech — WEB Bible, Biblia RVR, 和合本圣经, Bíblia AA.** Read-aloud Scripture playback.
- **No audio — ASV Bible, Bible Louis Segond 1910.** Reading and devotionals only.

Every app has all 4 devotional slots, including the sleep slot.
Only KJV Bible ships the dedicated Sleep Audio track.

## Apps

- [Word Rhythm: KJV Bible](https://wordrhythm.app/versions/kjv) (English) — offline KJV with morning, day, evening and before-bed devotionals, reading plans and memorization, plus **Sleep Audio** — gentle nighttime Scripture reading with soft pacing and peaceful background sounds. [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gyc.ace.kjv)
- [Word Rhythm: ASV Bible](https://wordrhythm.app/versions/asv) (English) — scholarly American Standard Version, reading and devotionals only. Text only, no audio. [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gyc.ace.asv)
- [Word Rhythm: WEB Bible](https://wordrhythm.app/versions/web) (English) — modern-language public-domain World English Bible, text-to-speech audio. [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gyc.ace.webu)
- [Word Rhythm: Biblia RVR](https://wordrhythm.app/versions/rvr) (Español) — Reina-Valera with four daily slots, text-to-speech audio. [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gyc.ace.esp)
- [Word Rhythm: 和合本圣经](https://wordrhythm.app/versions/cuv) (中文) — 和合本圣经（中文），含清晨、白天、夜晚与睡前四个时段。支持 TTS 朗读 [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gyc.ace.bible)
- [Word Rhythm: Bíblia AA](https://wordrhythm.app/versions/aa) (Português) — Almeida Atualizada with four daily slots, text-to-speech audio. [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.guanyc.ace.almeida)
- [Word Rhythm: Louis Segond 1910](https://wordrhythm.app/versions/lsg) (Français) — LSG 1910 hors ligne, méditation, plans de lecture et recherche. Texte uniquement, sans audio. [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gyc.ace.lsg)
- [All versions](https://wordrhythm.app/versions)

## KJV words

- [thee](https://wordrhythm.app/kjv-words/thee) — you (archaic objective form); Psalms 18:1
- [thou](https://wordrhythm.app/kjv-words/thou) — you (archaic subject form); Psalms 92:8
- [thy](https://wordrhythm.app/kjv-words/thy) — your (archaic possessive; Matthew 6:9
- [thine](https://wordrhythm.app/kjv-words/thine) — your (archaic possessive; Luke 20:43
- [ye](https://wordrhythm.app/kjv-words/ye) — you (archaic plural subject pronoun); Matthew 5:14
- [unto](https://wordrhythm.app/kjv-words/unto) — to (archaic preposition); John 8:1
- [hath](https://wordrhythm.app/kjv-words/hath) — has (third person singular); Luke 19:34
- [doth](https://wordrhythm.app/kjv-words/doth) — does (third person singular); Luke 1:46
- [didst](https://wordrhythm.app/kjv-words/didst) — did (second person singular); Psalms 39:9
- [dost](https://wordrhythm.app/kjv-words/dost) — do (second person singular); Psalms 44:12
- [shalt](https://wordrhythm.app/kjv-words/shalt) — shall (second person singular); Exodus 20:13
- [wilt](https://wordrhythm.app/kjv-words/wilt) — will (second person singular); Acts 7:28
- [saith](https://wordrhythm.app/kjv-words/saith) — says; Isaiah 40:1
- [knowest](https://wordrhythm.app/kjv-words/knowest) — you know (second person singular); Psalms 69:5
- [ought](https://wordrhythm.app/kjv-words/ought) — ought to; 1 John 4:11
- [verily](https://wordrhythm.app/kjv-words/verily) — truly; Psalms 66:19
- [wherefore](https://wordrhythm.app/kjv-words/wherefore) — why; for which reason; Matthew 6:30

- [lo](https://wordrhythm.app/kjv-words/lo) — look; Song of Solomon 2:11

- [Importunity](https://wordrhythm.app/kjv-words/importunity) — Importunity; persistent; Luke 11:8
- [Backslider](https://wordrhythm.app/kjv-words/backslider) — Backslider; one who turns away from God; Proverbs 14:14

- [wherewithal](https://wordrhythm.app/kjv-words/wherewithal) — the means (money/resources) to do something; Psalms 119:9
- [whilst](https://wordrhythm.app/kjv-words/whilst) — while; during (formal/archaic); Psalms 141:10
- [whisperings](https://wordrhythm.app/kjv-words/whisperings) — whispers; gossip; secret talk; 2 Corinthians 12:20
- [whosoever](https://wordrhythm.app/kjv-words/whosoever) — whoever; any person (emphatic); Luke 7:23
- [wist](https://wordrhythm.app/kjv-words/wist) — knew (archaic past tense of 'wit'); Luke 2:49
- [Full glossary of 1440 KJV words](https://wordrhythm.app/kjv-words)

Every entry in the glossary carries a modern equivalent, a definition and a
verbatim KJV example with its book, chapter and verse. The ones listed above
are the words readers look up most; all 1440 are searchable at
the link above.

## Facts

- Platform: Android only. Fully offline reading. No account required.
- 4 daily slots in every app: morning, day, evening, sleep.
- Reading plans, memorization and Take a Break are available in every app.
- Audio varies: Sleep Audio (KJV Bible), text-to-speech (WEB Bible, Biblia RVR, 和合本圣经, Bíblia AA), or none (ASV Bible, Bible Louis Segond 1910).
- Also available as a standalone app: [Take a Break](https://wordrhythm.app/take-a-break)
- KJV archaic-word glossary: 1440 entries, examples verified against the full KJV text.
